retrieval_method: read-only public API response via web browsing
market_scope: x402-list indexed services and monitored facilitators; not full ecosystem
caveats: Publisher data, not independently audited chain or verified buyers.
Buyer addresses do not imply distinct human customers or paying companies.
Top service has imported flow; largest buyer accounts for 98.8% of that service's measured flow.
Coverage is relative to publisher-measured facilitator flow, not the entire agent economy.
Supply counts and rolling 30-day settlement figures are not directly comparable as adoption measures.
Measured networks and coverage can change; cross-snapshot changes are not causal growth estimates.
decision_implication: Catalog supply increased versus 2026-10-13 while publisher-reported distinct buyer addresses and rolling measured settlement dollars declined. Demand capture and reliable distribution remain unproven; avoid building a generic directory or extrapolating TAM.
